query:
UPDATE channelmembers
               SET mentioncount       = $1,
                   mentioncountroot   = $2,
                   urgentmentioncount = $3,
                   msgcount     = (SELECT totalmsgcount     FROM channels WHERE id = $7) - $4,
                   msgcountroot = (SELECT totalmsgcountroot FROM channels WHERE id = $7) - $5,
                   lastviewedat = $6,
                   lastupdateat = $8
             WHERE userid = $9
               AND channelid = $7
